000390: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL String8 c_ir_scalar_type_name(CTypeKind kind)
000391: {
000392:     switch (kind)
000393:     {
000394:     case C_TYPE_VOID:
000395:         return S8("void");
000396:     case C_TYPE_BOOL:
000397:         return S8("_Bool");
000398:     case C_TYPE_CHAR:
000399:         return S8("char");
000400:     case C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR:
000401:         return S8("signed char");
000402:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR:
000403:         return S8("unsigned char");
000404:     case C_TYPE_SHORT:
000405:         return S8("short");
000406:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT:
000407:         return S8("unsigned short");
000408:     case C_TYPE_INT:
000409:         return S8("int");
000410:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT:
000411:         return S8("unsigned int");
000412:     case C_TYPE_LONG:
000413:         return S8("long");
000414:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG:
000415:         return S8("unsigned long");
000416:     case C_TYPE_LONG_LONG:
000417:         return S8("long long");
000418:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG:
000419:         return S8("unsigned long long");
000420:     case C_TYPE_INT128:
000421:         return S8("__int128");
000422:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128:
000423:         return S8("unsigned __int128");
000424:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16:
000425:     case C_TYPE_BFLOAT16:
000426:         return kind == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16 ? S8("__bf16") : S8("_Float16");
000427:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT:
000428:         return S8("float");
000429:     case C_TYPE_DOUBLE:
000430:         return S8("double");
000431:     case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE:
000432:         return S8("long double");
000433:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX:
000434:         return S8("_Float16 _Complex");
000435:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX:
000436:         return S8("float _Complex");
000437:     case C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
000438:         return S8("double _Complex");
000439:     case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
000440:         return S8("long double _Complex");
000441:     case C_TYPE_VA_LIST:
000442:         return S8("va_list");
000443:     case C_TYPE_NULLPTR:
000444:         return S8("nullptr_t");
000445:     case C_TYPE_INVALID:
000446:     case C_TYPE_POINTER:
000447:     case C_TYPE_ARRAY:
000448:     case C_TYPE_VECTOR:
000449:     case C_TYPE_FUNCTION:
000450:     case C_TYPE_STRUCT:
000451:     case C_TYPE_UNION:
000452:     case C_TYPE_ENUM:
000453:     case C_TYPE_COUNT:
000454:         return (String8){0};
000455:     }
000456:     return (String8){0};
000457: }

000459: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_scalar_type_properties(Target target, CTypeKind kind, IrTypeKind* ir_kind, u32* bit_width, bool* is_signed, u32* alignment)
000460: {
000461:     TargetDataLayout layout = target_data_layout(target);
000462:     *ir_kind = IR_TYPE_INTEGER;
000463:     *bit_width = 0;
000464:     *is_signed = false;
000465:     *alignment = 0;
000466:     switch (kind)
000467:     {
000468:     case C_TYPE_VOID:
000469:         *ir_kind = IR_TYPE_VOID;
000470:         return true;
000471:     case C_TYPE_BOOL:
000472:         *ir_kind = IR_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
000473:         *bit_width = layout.boolean.bit_width;
000474:         *alignment = layout.boolean.alignment;
000475:         return true;
000476:     case C_TYPE_CHAR:
000477:         *bit_width = layout.plain_char.bit_width;
000478:         *is_signed = layout.plain_char_is_signed;
000479:         *alignment = layout.plain_char.alignment;
000480:         return true;
000481:     case C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR:
000482:         *bit_width = layout.signed_char.bit_width;
000483:         *is_signed = true;
000484:         *alignment = layout.signed_char.alignment;
000485:         return true;
000486:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR:
000487:         *bit_width = layout.unsigned_char.bit_width;
000488:         *alignment = layout.unsigned_char.alignment;
000489:         return true;
000490:     case C_TYPE_SHORT:
000491:         *bit_width = layout.short_integer.bit_width;
000492:         *is_signed = true;
000493:         *alignment = layout.short_integer.alignment;
000494:         return true;
000495:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT:
000496:         *bit_width = layout.unsigned_short_integer.bit_width;
000497:         *alignment = layout.unsigned_short_integer.alignment;
000498:         return true;
000499:     case C_TYPE_INT:
000500:         *bit_width = layout.integer.bit_width;
000501:         *is_signed = true;
000502:         *alignment = layout.integer.alignment;
000503:         return true;
000504:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT:
000505:         *bit_width = layout.unsigned_integer.bit_width;
000506:         *alignment = layout.unsigned_integer.alignment;
000507:         return true;
000508:     case C_TYPE_LONG:
000509:         *bit_width = layout.long_integer.bit_width;
000510:         *is_signed = true;
000511:         *alignment = layout.long_integer.alignment;
000512:         return true;
000513:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG:
000514:         *bit_width = layout.unsigned_long_integer.bit_width;
000515:         *alignment = layout.unsigned_long_integer.alignment;
000516:         return true;
000517:     case C_TYPE_LONG_LONG:
000518:         *bit_width = layout.long_long_integer.bit_width;
000519:         *is_signed = true;
000520:         *alignment = layout.long_long_integer.alignment;
000521:         return true;
000522:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG:
000523:         *bit_width = layout.unsigned_long_long_integer.bit_width;
000524:         *alignment = layout.unsigned_long_long_integer.alignment;
000525:         return true;
000526:     case C_TYPE_INT128:
000527:         *bit_width = layout.integer128.bit_width;
000528:         *is_signed = true;
000529:         *alignment = layout.integer128.alignment;
000530:         return true;
000531:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128:
000532:         *bit_width = layout.unsigned_integer128.bit_width;
000533:         *alignment = layout.unsigned_integer128.alignment;
000534:         return true;
000535:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16:
000536:     case C_TYPE_BFLOAT16:
000537:     {
000538:         TargetTypeLayout narrow = kind == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16 ? layout.bfloat16_type : layout.float16_type;
000539:         *ir_kind = IR_TYPE_FLOAT;
000540:         *bit_width = narrow.bit_width;
000541:         *alignment = narrow.alignment;
000542:         return true;
000543:     }
000544:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT:
000545:         *ir_kind = IR_TYPE_FLOAT;
000546:         *bit_width = layout.float_type.bit_width;
000547:         *alignment = layout.float_type.alignment;
000548:         return true;
000549:     case C_TYPE_DOUBLE:
000550:         *ir_kind = IR_TYPE_FLOAT;
000551:         *bit_width = layout.double_type.bit_width;
000552:         *alignment = layout.double_type.alignment;
000553:         return true;
000554:     case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE:
000555:         *ir_kind = IR_TYPE_FLOAT;
000556:         *bit_width = layout.long_double_type.bit_width;
000557:         *alignment = layout.long_double_type.alignment;
000558:         return true;
000559:     case C_TYPE_VA_LIST:
000560:         *ir_kind = IR_TYPE_VA_LIST;
000561:         *bit_width = layout.va_list.bit_width;
000562:         *alignment = layout.va_list.alignment;
